verdict.rationale: Codex skills use a SKILL.md-in-a-directory format with required `name` and `description` frontmatter. They are discovered from a vendor-neutral `.agents/skills` path, and a community user notes that Claude Skills are "coming to Codex," which implies a shared cross-vendor format. Plugins also offer a portable Agent Plugins schema and a migration path from Claude Code. However, no evidence explicitly says Codex skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification or that a skill folder is guaranteed valid in other vendors' tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conformance to the open Agent Skills spec, hands-on evidence of the same skill folder working in non-OpenAI tooling.
